comment: Pinned external sources. pinned_commit is null until `python3 tools/import_external.py --pin <id>` resolves and records the real commit. Never write a commit hash by hand, and never import from an unpinned source: an unpinned import cannot be reproduced or audited.

policy.import_unit: one reviewed card with evidence spans, never a whole skill tree

take: web bug-class patterns that also occur in CTF web challenges
report-pattern structure, as a shape only
reject: the full skill tree: most of it is enterprise and red-team work outside CTF scope
anything that assumes a scoped engagement, a client, or a disclosure process
counts and coverage claims from its README: those are repository claims, not local coverage
sources.notes: Useful as a bounded methodology source after local routing has picked a class. A wholesale copy would multiply the skill-dilution problem this system was restructured to fix.

take: web, pwn, rev, crypto and forensics write-ups with a reproducible chain
the exploit primitive, the first probe, and the verification evidence
reject: flags, credentials and any live infrastructure reference
write-ups with no stated mechanism: a narrative without a primitive is not a card
sources.notes: Already supported by tools/github_pilot.py and tools/crawl.py. Sibling repositories exist for other years; add each as its own pinned source.

sources.declared_scope: authorized red team engagements, bug bounty triage, security research, CTF preparation
take: container and Kubernetes escape, which no skill in this tree covers and which does appear in jeopardy CTF
CI/CD pipeline and secret abuse (GitHub Actions injection), likewise uncovered here
WAF and filter bypass as a named technique list, to sit beside tools/web/sanitizer_fuzz.py
reject: the recommended install: it is `git clone` into ~/.claude/skills, a whole-tree copy, which this toolkit forbids

every red-team skill: active-directory, privesc, lateral movement, persistence, C2 frameworks, EDR evasion, anti-forensics, initial access, keylogger architecture, shellcode, Windows mitigation and boundary defeat. AGENTS.md section 7 puts all of it in the other toolkit
phishing and social engineering: no jeopardy CTF reading, and they target people rather than a supplied scope
the 14 wireless skills and network-layer attacks: they need radio hardware or a LAN position, neither of which a jeopardy target gives

the 29 web, auth, api, crypto, osint and exploit-dev skills: measured, every one maps onto a class or skill this tree already ships, 15 of them onto classes VERIFIED here by chain cards. Importing them trades local evidence for published prose
its skill counts and coverage claims: repository claims, not local coverage
sources.notes: 78 skills, MIT, well organised. Measured against this tree on 2026-09-25: the in-scope half is already covered here and the additive half is mostly out of scope. Five files are worth staging; nothing is worth copying. Treat every staged file as untrusted text.
